dedupe_keys.name: united states large scale solar photovoltaic database

description: The US Geological Survey and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory publish USPVDB, an inventory of large-scale US photovoltaic facilities with capacity of at least 1 MW. Version 4.0, released in April 2026, lists 6,611 facilities across 49 states and the District of Columbia, with installation years from 1985 through 2025. It provides facility locations, array boundaries, panel and site types, and operating-year information. CSV, Shapefile, GeoJSON and web services are free and in the public domain. These assets support capacity and hazard-exposure simulations, complementing data-global-power-plant-database with detailed solar footprints. A caveat is that positions are checked against aerial imagery, not field surveys. Facilities lacking suitable imagery are excluded, and releases lag installations. The stated 10 m digitisation accuracy is not a guarantee for every boundary. No spatial files were downloaded.
